about_the_game:
SIR ABANDON – A DEEP METROIDVANIA EXPERIENCE

Dive into the world of SIR ABANDON, a Metroidvania that blends platforming, exploration, and RPG mechanics in a non-linear open world filled with secrets and challenges.

EXPLORE A LIVING WORLD FULL OF SECRETS

  • Discover interconnected areas, hidden treasures, and numerous secret passages.

  • Complete main and side quests that shape your adventure and influence your progression.

  • Achieve milestones to unlock powerful rewards.

CLASS SYSTEM & CHARACTER PROGRESSION

  • Choose from multiple playable classes, each with unique combat styles and abilities.

  • Gain experience, level up, and allocate talent points to customize and strengthen your hero.

  • Equip yourself with weapons and armor tailored to your playstyle.

FARMING, CRAFTING & GAME ECONOMY

  • Loot and farm valuable resources by defeating formidable enemies.

  • Sell your items to purchase better gear.

  • Craft weapons and armor using materials collected throughout your journey.

RICH & CHALLENGING GAMEPLAY

  • A dynamic combat system requiring strategy and quick reflexes.

  • Epic boss fights, demanding mastery of the game’s mechanics.

  • A captivating artistic direction, supported by an epic soundtrack.

WHY PLAY SIR ABANDON?

If you love challenging Metroidvania games that focus on exploration, customization, and progression, then SIR ABANDON is for you!

Get ready to take on the challenge and uncover the mysteries of a fascinating world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with side buttons is required to play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with side buttons is required to play.

short_description: SIR ABANDON is an open-world Metroidvania RPG blending exploration, dynamic combat, and character progression. Complete quests, battle epic bosses, find hidden treasures, and upgrade your hero with a class system, gear, and talents.
supported_languages:
English, French*, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
